messages.subject: Hartnell - draft settlement agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Bartlett,

Following the agreement in principle, please find attached our first draft of the settlement agreement for Mr Hartnell's consideration and your mark-up. The financial terms in this draft reflect the opening position and will be updated to the agreed figures; we have flagged the schedules (adviser's certificate and agreed reference) for your input.

We look forward to your comments.

Kind regards,
Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP
